question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**killed**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given passage, the blank 5 will explain how the red kites were killed the same in the US as well.
 
• Among the given options:
 
 
• **"Killed" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**
 
• **This verb means to make somebody/something die.** (किसी को मारना, किसी का मारा जाना)
 
• Example: They killed the rabbit while hitting it with stones.
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "killed" fits the context of the sentence.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Awakened" means to become conscious or aware of something, and it is not appropriate in this context. (प्रबुद्ध)
 
• "Subjected" means to expose someone or something to a particular experience or treatment, but it is not appropriate in this context. (अधीन)
 
• "Rooted" means to establish or become fixed, but it is not appropriate in this context. (आधारित)
